items.summary_cn: Musk披露SpaceX在月球建制造基地计划，利好航天板块情绪，间接支撑kcn的SPCX/SPCH。

items.author: Musk
items.text: What to know about Elon Musk's potential $10B Tesla solar facility in Fort Bend
items.summary_cn: 报道Musk旗下Tesla可能在Fort Bend建100亿美元太阳能设施，影响Tesla及太阳能板块情绪(间接)。

items.text: Elon Musk's Boring Company Is Raising Money at a $20 Billion Valuation. Here's How His Empire Outside Tesla Is Growing.
